overview: This Senate resolution directs the Secretary of the Senate to tell the House of Representatives that a quorum, meaning enough senators to conduct business, is present and that the Senate is ready to get to work. It is a standard opening step each time a new Congress begins. The Senate approved it on January 3, 2025, and sent the message to the House on January 6, 2025.
for: Supporters say this long-standing step formally signals that the new Senate is organized and open for business.
against: Critics say the resolution is a routine formality that does not change any law or policy.
